docs.summary: A block of rich text. Parsing and effect evaluation live here, and everything about *text* stays in Scribe. The block tells Scribe each character's font, size and decoration through a [`GlyphCustomizer`](#api~Prowl.Scribe.GlyphCustomizer), lets Scribe lay the text out, and then adjusts each glyph on the way to the renderer through a [`GlyphModifier`](#api~Prowl.Scribe.GlyphModifier). That keeps kerning, ligatures, line breaking, alignment and underline/strike decorations in the one place that already knows how to do them.
False when the markup is styled but never moves, so a frame can skip effect work.
